status: ALL 64 original focused span hashes reproduce; no source or strict evidence change.
scope: Convention correction only; no Lean/build/Git/repository edits. Original pin and review artifacts remain unchanged.

physical-inclusive-line-bytes.operation: Concatenate source.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)[first_line - 1:last_line]. Hash those bytes without decoding or normalization.
physical-inclusive-line-bytes.final_lf: Retained exactly if present in the selected final physical line.
physical-inclusive-line-bytes.trailing_blank_lines: Retained exactly when included by the stated line range.

utf8-python-str-rstrip.operation: Select the same physical inclusive line bytes, decode UTF-8, apply Python str.rstrip() with no arguments, encode UTF-8, then hash.
utf8-python-str-rstrip.line_numbers: One-based; both endpoints inclusive before rstrip.
utf8-python-str-rstrip.final_lf: Removed with all other trailing Unicode whitespace. No final LF is added.
utf8-python-str-rstrip.trailing_blank_lines: Removed with all other trailing Unicode whitespace.
utf8-python-str-rstrip.warning: The final line number states the pre-trim slice; it is not necessarily the last line represented by the hashed content.
